# MDSync core

Upstream: https://github.com/k1tbyte/mdsync
Commit: 6f0190efd517b709ff21c4d77bcc0b221bce52b6 (1.5.1, MIT).

Generated by tools/mdsync/build.mjs. The manifest publisher requires atomic ETag writes. The S3 adapter accepts a QingYu request handler for rotating cloud credentials. The scanner accepts verified asset hashes from the QingYu adapter when the reported size and modification time match. Obsidian host calls use tools/mdsync/host.ts.

Bundled third-party dependencies retain their legal comments in core.js. Input files are recorded in inputs.json.
